say:0:1011201001:0.text: Mr. Korin, you've been clutching your arms, are you alright?
say:0:1011201001:0.source_cn: 科林先生，看你一路都在捂着肩膀和手肘，身体还好吗？

say:1:1011201002:0.text: Don't worry about me, Miss Hamster. Let's keep moving.
say:1:1011201002:0.source_cn: 没事。仓鼠小姑娘，抓紧赶路吧。

say:2:1011201003:0.text: Hmm... Let us know if you're not feeling well. Don't try to tough it out like Chippy!
say:2:1011201003:0.source_cn: 唔……好吧，科林先生，要是你哪里不舒服，别像满满一样逞强。

say:0:1011202001:0.source_cn: 我说，这个营地看着……已经被废弃了？

say:1:1011202002:0.text: It could be where the refugees were camped before. Let's see if we can find any clues.
say:1:1011202002:0.source_cn: 可能是那些难民之前的扎营的地方，不知道会有什么线索。
say:1:1011202002:0.male: It could be where the refugees were camped before. Let's see if we can find any clues.
say:1:1011202002:0.female: It could be where the refugees were camped before. Let's see if we can find any clues.

say:2:1011203001:1.text: Abandoned shoes, scattered mats, toppled tents, and unfinished mushroom soup...
say:2:1011203001:1.source_cn: 不成对的便鞋，没喝完的蘑菇汤，还有散落一地的草席和营帐……

say:3:1011203002:1.text: Looks like they left in a hurry...
say:3:1011203002:1.source_cn: 看来那些难民朋友，走得很匆忙……

say:4:1011203003:1.text: They mentioned being initially permitted to enter the forest for a brief respite. However, they were suddenly expelled by armed guards in the middle of the night... Just look at the chaos left behind!
say:4:1011203003:1.source_cn: 据他们说，一开始还被允许进入丛林的时候，他们暂时在这里...

say:5:1011203004:1.text: I arrived when they were fleeing in disarray. There were hardly any young men capable of protecting them!
say:5:1011203004:1.source_cn: 我来的时候，正赶上难民互相搀扶着往外流离转徙，队伍里连...

choice_prompt:6:1011203004.text: I arrived when they were fleeing in disarray. There were hardly any young men capable of protecting them!
choice_prompt:6:1011203004.source_cn: 我来的时候，正赶上难民互相搀扶着往外流离转徙，队伍里连能保护他们的青壮年都没几个！

say:7:1011203005:1.text: I retired from the army long ago. I came to the <style="highlight">Dark Forest</style> looking for someone.
say:7:1011203005:1.source_cn: 我早退伍了，来薄暮丛林是为<style=highlig...
say:7:1011203005:1.male: I retired from the army long ago. I came to the <style="highlight">Dark Forest</style> looking for someone.
say:7:1011203005:1.female: I retired from the army long ago. I came to the <style="highlight">Dark Forest</style> looking for someone.

say:9:1011203006:0.text: No wonder! Those refugees don't look like they can afford to shell out money and hire a guard.
say:9:1011203006:0.source_cn: 怪不得！那些难民不像是能掏得起钱，雇佣你做护卫的样子。

say:10:1011203007:0.text: You are such a nice guy!
say:10:1011203007:0.source_cn: 看不出来，老兄你人还挺好的嘛！

say:11:1011203008:0.text: Well... I have my reasons. How am I supposed to find anyone if there's an exclusion edict?
say:11:1011203008:0.source_cn: ……我也有私心。封锁令不解，要怎么进去找人？

say:13:1011203009:0.source_cn: 帮助难民，不过顺手而为罢了。

say:14:1011203010:1.text: The Thorned Guards used to be different... While they were conservative, many guards risked their lives when hypofiends were rampant, safeguarding the peace of the forest.
say:14:1011203010:1.source_cn: 荆棘卫队，以前不是这样的……他们虽然保守，但以前魔物大...

say:15:1011203011:1.text: But now, with the corruption, disturbances in the forest, and <style="highlight">Master Eomir</style>'s influence, they have become radical to such an extent...
say:15:1011203011:1.source_cn: 但现在内有腐化，外有骚扰，有<style=highli...

say:16:1011203012:0.text: Hmph, "master"? The title of a sage should be reserved for those who make wiser decisions.
say:16:1011203012:0.source_cn: 哼，贤者？做出这种决断的人，你们竟然还称他为贤者？

say:17:1011203013:1.text: Despite being strict, everyone respects Master Eomir as he once led the guards at the forefront against the hypofiends.
say:17:1011203013:1.source_cn: 伊米尔贤者曾经亲自率领卫队站在抗争魔物的第一线，虽然有...

say:18:1011203014:0.text: The teachings we received from childhood were that Windwhisperers heed the forest's whispers, Dusk Patrollers embrace its goodness, while Thorned Guards keep the peace. The three factions support and assist each other.
say:18:1011203014:0.source_cn: 我们从小受到的教导是，风语倾听丛林之声，薄暮传承丛林之...

choice_prompt:19:1011203014.text: The teachings we received from childhood were that Windwhisperers heed the forest's whispers, Dusk Patrollers embrace its goodness, while Thorned Guards keep the peace. The three factions support and assist each other.
choice_prompt:19:1011203014.source_cn: 我们从小受到的教导是，风语倾听丛林之声，薄暮传承丛林之德，荆棘守护丛林之静，三重力量彼此支撑，彼此协助……

say:23:1011203016:0.text: Let us go! We're only looking for healing!
say:23:1011203016:0.source_cn: ——放过我们吧！我们只是想进去找人求医而已！

say:24:1011203017:0.text: I don't know who you're looking for, but we didn't do anything... Leave us alone!
say:24:1011203017:0.source_cn: 我不知道你们在找谁，我们什么都没做……放过我们！

say:27:1011203018:0.text: Hey! Did you hear people calling for help?
say:27:1011203018:0.source_cn: 喂——你们听见了吗！前面有人在呼救！

say:28:1011203019:0.text: Could it be that the Thorned Guards are evicting people again?
say:28:1011203019:0.source_cn: 难道是荆棘卫队又在赶人？！

choice:19:0:1.text: Looks like the Thorned Faction has a bigger say.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 但现在看起来，荆棘话语权很大？
choice:19:0:1.male: Looks like the Thorned Faction has a bigger say.
choice:19:0:1.female: Looks like the Thorned Faction has a bigger say.

choice:6:0:1.text: So you weren't one of them?
choice:6:0:1.male: So you weren't one of them?
choice:6:0:1.female: So you weren't one of them?

say:0:1011204001:0.text: Weird... I hear familiar voices other than cries for help.
say:0:1011204001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，除了呼救声，好像还有其他熟悉的声音……

say:1:1011204002:0.text: Hurry! Let's go see what happened!

say:3:1011206001:1.text: <style="highlight">Eironn</style>?! What are you doing here?! Weren't you off on a world tour to sharpen your swordsmanship?

say:4:1011206002:1.text: Eironn came back a few days before you. He helped us remove the corrupted roots and tried to persuade the Thorned Guards to lift the exclusion edict.
say:4:1011206002:1.source_cn: 埃隆他比你早回来几天，一回到丛林，就开始帮助我们清除腐...

say:5:1011206003:1.text: But it appears they won't heed anyone's words...
say:5:1011206003:1.source_cn: 不过荆棘他们，现在好像谁的话也听不进去了……

choice_prompt:6:1011206003.text: But it appears they won't heed anyone's words...
choice_prompt:6:1011206003.source_cn: 不过荆棘他们，现在好像谁的话也听不进去了……

say:7:1011206004:0.text: My apologies. I am Eironn, a swordsman-in-training.
say:7:1011206004:0.source_cn: 真是失礼了……我是埃隆，一名还不成器的剑客。
say:7:1011206004:0.male: My apologies. I am Eironn, a swordsman-in-training.
say:7:1011206004:0.female: My apologies. I am Eironn, a swordsman-in-training.

say:8:1011206005:0.text: In training?! Oh please, you haven't changed a bit! Your swordsmanship is second to none in the entire forest!
say:8:1011206005:0.source_cn: 什么“不成器”，你那妄自菲薄的毛病一点没改！整个丛林里...

say:9:1011206006:0.text: *Sigh* My old friend, your habit of exaggerating has not changed.
say:9:1011206006:0.source_cn: 唉，我的友人，你爱夸大其词的习惯也丝毫未变。

choice_prompt:10:1011206006.text: *Sigh* My old friend, your habit of exaggerating has not changed.
choice_prompt:10:1011206006.source_cn: 唉，我的友人，你爱夸大其词的习惯也丝毫未变。

say:11:1011206007:0.text: Yes. Lorsan, Lyca, and I grew up together. They became apprentices of the two sages, and I left the forest to sharpen my skills.
say:11:1011206007:0.source_cn: 正是。洛桑、莱卡和我，我们三个从小一起长大。后来莱卡和...
say:11:1011206007:0.male: Yes. Lorsan, Lyca, and I grew up together. They became apprentices of the two sages, and I left the forest to sharpen my skills.
say:11:1011206007:0.female: Yes. Lorsan, Lyca, and I grew up together. They became apprentices of the two sages, and I left the forest to sharpen my skills.

say:12:1011206008:0.text: He's the one always muttering, "This isn't the path I'm seeking" or "My sword needs a clearer purpose." Then he ditched Lyca and me and went off on his solo quest!
say:12:1011206008:0.source_cn: 嗯，就他不在丛林好好待着，总说“这不是我想寻求的方向”...
say:12:1011206008:0.male: He's the one always muttering, "This isn't the path I'm seeking" or "My sword needs a clearer purpose." Then he ditched Lyca and me and went off on his solo quest!
say:12:1011206008:0.female: He's the one always muttering, "This isn't the path I'm seeking" or "My sword needs a clearer purpose." Then he ditched Lyca and me and went off on his solo quest!

say:13:1011206009:1.text: Hold on... Where are the refugees? Are they hurt?
say:13:1011206009:1.source_cn: 说起来……啊，那些难民呢！他们有没有受伤？

say:19:1011206010:0.text: Take your time. I see... You were trying to get inside for medical help, but those cursed Thorned Guards wanted to arrest you.
say:19:1011206010:0.source_cn: ……慢慢说。你们只是想进去求医，那些荆棘的混蛋就想把你...

say:20:1011206011:0.text: Yes! Oh, thank goodness you're humans! I didn't think anyone else had escaped their search!
say:20:1011206011:0.source_cn: 哦——你，你们是人类！太好了，没想到还有同胞躲过他们的搜查！

say:21:1011206012:1.text: When those Wilders came at night, we hid on a small islet across the river amid the chaos. Then one of the refugees started running a high fever...
say:21:1011206012:1.source_cn: 那些绿裔半夜来时，我们趁乱躲在河对岸的小洲上。但是涉水...

say:22:1011206013:1.text: We had no choice, so we thought we'd sneak into the forest while those guys were on patrol.
say:22:1011206013:1.source_cn: 我们实在没办法，才想着趁那些人巡逻的间隙，溜进丛林找人治病。

say:23:1011206014:0.text: Then they came back and interrogated us about <style="highlight">Damian</style>'s whereabouts, as if we had captured a Wilder boy!
say:23:1011206014:0.source_cn: 结果他们突然折返回来，还逼问我们“<style=hig...

say:24:1011206015:0.text: Damian... Did you just say Damian?!
say:24:1011206015:0.source_cn: 达米安…你刚才是说达米安吗？！

choice_prompt:25:1011206015.text: Damian... Did you just say Damian?!
choice_prompt:25:1011206015.source_cn: <style=highlight>达米安</style>……你刚才是说达米安吗？！

say:26:1011206016:0.text: He's the reason why I came to the Dark Forest!
say:26:1011206016:0.source_cn: 我来薄暮丛林，就是为了找他！
say:26:1011206016:0.male: He's the reason why I came to the Dark Forest!
say:26:1011206016:0.female: He's the reason why I came to the Dark Forest!

say:29:1011206018:0.text: Damian is missing, but I don't think the Lightbearer refugees are responsible. The Thorned Guards are too biased to be trusted.
say:29:1011206018:0.source_cn: 达米安确实失踪了，但我不觉得是耀光难民所为。荆棘卫队…...

say:30:1011206019:0.text: I've searched the area before and didn't find anything. How's it going outside the forest?
say:30:1011206019:0.source_cn: 之前我已在这附近搜寻过，一无所获。丛林外情况如何？

say:34:1011206021:0.text: Argh, you're right! Finding Damian is my personal task. These refugees can't be left alone.
say:34:1011206021:0.source_cn: 可恶……你说得对，找达米安只是我个人的私心，但这些难民...
say:34:1011206021:0.male: Argh, you're right! Finding Damian is my personal task. These refugees can't be left alone.
say:34:1011206021:0.female: Argh, you're right! Finding Damian is my personal task. These refugees can't be left alone.

say:38:1011206022:0.text: Rather than extending a helping hand, the Thorned Guards are forcing them to leave...
say:38:1011206022:0.source_cn: 遭受困难的友人来到家门口，荆棘卫队不但不伸出援手，反而...

say:39:1011206023:0.text: Don't worry, Mr. Korin. Damian is our friend, and we will find him.
say:39:1011206023:0.source_cn: 科林先生，您别着急，达米安是绿裔的人，我们应当尽责。

say:40:1011206024:0.text: Let the Dusk Patrollers escort these refugees back to the campsite. With the patrollers by their side, the Thorned Guards shouldn't trouble them anymore.
say:40:1011206024:0.source_cn: 让薄暮巡游队的队员护送这些难民朋友，回刚才的营地休息吧...

say:43:1011206025:1.text: Chippy will take care of informing everyone! Chippy can run super fast!
say:43:1011206025:1.source_cn: 通知的事情就交给我来吧！我跑得快！

say:44:1011206026:0.text: Thank you. This is a <style="highlight">message leaf</style> we use for communication. Please take it to Patroller Lena, and she will arrange everything.

say:45:1011206027:0.text: Don't you worry! Chippy the Acorn Knight will complete the mission!
say:45:1011206027:0.source_cn: 放心，骑士满满，保证完成任务！

say:47:1011206029:0.source_cn: 唉，达米安那小子，到底跑去了哪里……！

choice:33:0:1.text: Refugees first, then we find the boy.
choice:33:0:1.male: Refugees first, then we find the boy.
choice:33:0:1.female: Refugees first, then we find the boy.

say:49:1011206017:0.text:
He's the reason why I came to the Dark Forest!
Kidnapped?! But Damian is a Wilder... Who would kidnap him?
say:49:1011206017:0.source_cn: 我来薄暮丛林，就是为了找他！\n可他被绑架？达米安是绿...
say:49:1011206017:0.male:
He's the reason why I came to the Dark Forest!
Kidnapped?! But Damian is a Wilder... Who would kidnap him?
say:49:1011206017:0.female:
He's the reason why I came to the Dark Forest!
Kidnapped?! But Damian is a Wilder... Who would kidnap him?

choice:25:1:2.source_cn: 刚才好像听他们说，达米安被绑架……

choice:6:1:2.text: Don't leave me out of the conversation!
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你们聊天也带我一个啊
choice:6:1:2.male: Don't leave me out of the conversation!
choice:6:1:2.female: Don't leave me out of the conversation!

say:0:1011208001:0.text: Bryon, when did you send out your falcon?
say:0:1011208001:0.source_cn: 布莱恩，你这只鹰是什么时候放出去的？！

say:1:1011208002:0.text: While you were trying to race me.
say:1:1011208002:0.source_cn: 在您试图和我竞速的时候。

say:2:1011208003:0.text: Elona discerned Damian's figure within... the <style="highlight">Bizarre Labyrinth</style>.
say:2:1011208003:0.source_cn: 艾洛娜在空中俯瞰到了达米安的身影……在<style=h...

say:0:1011209001:0.text: So Damian is the reason why Mr. Korin came all the way to the Dark Forest.
say:0:1011209001:0.source_cn: 没想到科林先生是为找达米安才来薄暮丛林的。

say:1:1011209002:0.text: I need to talk to him about some personal matters.

say:2:1011209003:0.text: Please take good care of those refugees, Little Miss Rabbit.
say:2:1011209003:0.source_cn: 兔子小姑娘，帮忙安置那些难民，谢了。

say:0:1011210001:0.text: Navigating here is quite disorienting. Stay close, everyone. Follow my lead.
say:0:1011210001:0.source_cn: 这里非常容易迷失方向，诸位，跟紧我。

say:0:1011211001:0.text: So this is the Bizarre Labyrinth... Why are there so many portals?
say:0:1011211001:0.source_cn: 这就是诡幻迷宫……怎么会有这么多传送石门？
say:0:1011211001:0.male: So this is the Bizarre Labyrinth... Why are there so many portals?
say:0:1011211001:0.female: So this is the Bizarre Labyrinth... Why are there so many portals?

say:1:1011211002:0.text: It's a relic from centuries ago, even the oldest elder don't know where it came from.
say:1:1011211002:0.source_cn: 这是数百年前的遗迹，最年长的长者也不知道它的来历。
say:1:1011211002:0.male: It's a relic from centuries ago, even the oldest elder don't know where it came from.
say:1:1011211002:0.female: It's a relic from centuries ago, even the oldest elder don't know where it came from.

say:2:1011211003:0.text: It's very easy to get lost in here. The Dusk Patrollers don't come here often either.
say:2:1011211003:0.source_cn: 嗯，这里很容易迷路，所以我们巡游队也不常来。
say:2:1011211003:0.male: It's very easy to get lost in here. The Dusk Patrollers don't come here often either.
say:2:1011211003:0.female: It's very easy to get lost in here. The Dusk Patrollers don't come here often either.

say:0:1011212001:0.text: There are footprints here, and they're quite scattered... Looks like a lot of people have passed by.
say:0:1011212001:0.source_cn: 大家，这里有革靴的鞋印，而且相当散乱……看起来像是有很...

say:1:1011212002:0.text: Are these Damian's footprints? Are there people after him?
say:1:1011212002:0.source_cn: 是达米安？难道有人在追赶他？

say:0:1011213001:0.text: What's this? Oh, a cute toy car with... wings?
say:0:1011213001:0.source_cn: 唔，这是什么？挺可爱的玩具车……但长着翅膀？

say:1:1011213002:0.text: That must be Damian's little gadget. He loves tinkering with these odd inventions!
say:1:1011213002:0.source_cn: 一看就是达米安的小玩意，他最喜欢鼓捣这些奇奇怪怪的发明了！

say:2:1011213003:0.text: Damian loves his creation. How could he have left it on the side of the road... No, he's in danger!
say:2:1011213003:0.source_cn: 达米安很爱惜他的造物，怎么会丢在路边……不对，他有危险！

say:0:1011214001:0.text: I can hear him! It's Damian's voice!
say:0:1011214001:0.source_cn: 我听到了！是达米安的声音！

say:4:1011217003:1.text: B-But you can't move your arms!
say:4:1011217003:1.source_cn: 但是、但是你的手，不能动了呀！

say:5:1011217004:1.text: I'm not surprised. My arms were already approaching their limit. Making it this far has exceeded my expectations.
say:5:1011217004:1.source_cn: 意料之中，本来就快到时限了。能一路撑到这里，已经超乎期待。

say:6:1011217005:1.text: Be proud of your work, young man.
say:6:1011217005:1.source_cn: 挺起胸膛来，小子！为自己自豪吧，你做的东西，很不错。

choice_prompt:7:1011217005.text: Be proud of your work, young man.
choice_prompt:7:1011217005.source_cn: 挺起胸膛来，小子！为自己自豪吧，你做的东西，很不错。

say:8:1011217006:1.text: Korin's arms are pro... <style="highlight">prosthetics</style> I made for him.
say:8:1011217006:1.source_cn: 科林大叔的双手，是……是我给他做的……<style=h...
say:8:1011217006:1.male: Korin's arms are pro... <style="highlight">prosthetics</style> I made for him.
say:8:1011217006:1.female: Korin's arms are pro... <style="highlight">prosthetics</style> I made for him.

choice_prompt:9:1011217006.text: Korin's arms are pro... <style="highlight">prosthetics</style> I made for him.
choice_prompt:9:1011217006.source_cn: 科林大叔的双手，是……是我给他做的……<style=highlight>义肢</style>。
choice_prompt:9:1011217006.male: Korin's arms are pro... <style="highlight">prosthetics</style> I made for him.
choice_prompt:9:1011217006.female: Korin's arms are pro... <style="highlight">prosthetics</style> I made for him.

say:10:1011217007:1.text: It's either life or death on the battlefield.
say:10:1011217007:1.male: It's either life or death on the battlefield.
say:10:1011217007:1.female: It's either life or death on the battlefield.

say:11:1011217008:1.text: I'm lucky enough to have lived. Losing my arms didn't prevent me from joining the army. After retiring, I encountered Damian, who was out collecting materials...
say:11:1011217008:1.source_cn: 我已经非常幸运了，失去双手不影响行军，才能苟活至今。退...
say:11:1011217008:1.male: I'm lucky enough to have lived. Losing my arms didn't prevent me from joining the army. After retiring, I encountered Damian, who was out collecting materials...
say:11:1011217008:1.female: I'm lucky enough to have lived. Losing my arms didn't prevent me from joining the army. After retiring, I encountered Damian, who was out collecting materials...

say:13:1011217010:1.source_cn: 没关系，科林大叔，等找到合适的材料，我再给你做双新的手臂！
